{{Citation}}
{{Quote|Carbon is used to create duraplast, which we use for building.|[[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]]|<ref name="SW:GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
'''Duraplast''' was a white metal used during production of protective equipment. It was much stronger than many other metals, and was thus widely used throughout the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] Navies. The main element used in synthesizing duraplast was [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]].

Duraplast was also used in armor, such as [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|''Katarn''-class commando armor]] and variants of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]], and was capable of offering great external and internal protection up to medium grenades, [[Verpine shatter gun]] rounds, explosive [[Slug/Legends|slugs]], and medium [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] rounds. Duraplast could also be reinforced to be extremely resistant to [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|EMP]] and [[ion cannon]] warfare.

Duraplast may resist several [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] strikes if combined with cortosis, for instance.<ref name="SWTOROE">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Duraplast was used in Republic Trooper and Imperial Heavy Trooper Armor.<ref name="SWTOROE" />

[[Lerrimore Contracting Company]]'s [[industrial glow rod]] was constructed of sturdy duraplast designed to protect the illumination device from falls and being banged.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
